title: Checkpoint IV: Concurrent Rooms
prerequisite: Lessons 17–20. The relevant pattern is intentionally not announced.
hints: Process meetings by start time and track the end times of meetings currently occupying rooms.
The smallest active end time tells whether any room is available for the next meeting, so use a min-priority queue.
Release every meeting ending by the next start, add the new end time, and track the largest active-queue size.
